name: International Protection (UNHCR Mandate RSD)

requirements.blocker_text: Must establish a well-founded fear of persecution to UNHCR, which processes asylum claims directly for Saint Lucia (no dedicated domestic asylum legislation or national refugee status determination procedure).

evidence_required.document: Personal account/testimony at UNHCR RSD interview

sources.title: UNHCR Northern and Eastern Caribbean -- Apply for Asylum through UNHCR: confirms Saint Lucia is among the countries/territories (alongside Anguilla, Antigua and Barbuda, Barbados, Bermuda, British Virgin Islands, Dominica, Grenada, Haiti, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, Sint Maarten) where UNHCR processes asylum claims directly rather than the local government

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Saint Lucia's initial build. Built as draft (not excluded) following this session's established three-bucket humanitarian framework: a real process exists (UNHCR direct-mandate RSD, per the same regional page used for Antigua's, BVI's, Sint Maarten's, and Saint Kitts and Nevis' equivalents), and no country-specific negative finding (like the Bahamas' or Curacao/Aruba's documented forced-return practices) was located for Saint Lucia specifically to justify exclusion instead. STATUS: DRAFT because sourcing is tier-2 (UNHCR regional page) only, with no Saint Lucia-specific government source, implementing legislation, or detailed rights framework found -- modelled with the same conservative generic outcome (no work/study rights, family reunification only) used for the other UNHCR-direct-processing-group countries built this session.
